summary: 25-year-old mountain biker crashed on the Walker Ranch Loop trail (~3/4 down from the trailhead), suffering hip and arm injuries and unable to move; found by two other riders who called 911; AMR drove directly to him, clear ~9:15 p.m.
location: Walker Ranch Loop trail, southwestern Boulder County
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group + Coal Creek Canyon Fire + Rocky Mountain Fire + AMR + Boulder County Sheriff
notes: BCSO case 17-2112. Victim identified in release as William Buckner. Incident type 'injury' per the mountain-biker precedent.
